# Accounts Overview

Accounts Overview

There are 4 Tabs on the accounts page

1. Invoices - here you can find all invoices raised and filter by Invoice #, Status, Order #, and Company. 

![Image 5](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/acf6efdb-3c3c-48bb-9094-c4b5a944abd9.png)

2. Receipts

See all invoices recorded and Void any receipts where necessary

![Image 4](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/aca9f50f-728a-47e0-a5dc-aecca33310ef.png)

3. Customer Statements

On this tab you can see all Customers with a summary of their financial position. You can select whether or not they will received monthly statements. NOTE: This needs setting up on the Accounts setup.

![Image 3](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/abf75f41-e554-4db8-8aa8-29c517598c26.png)

You can click on any company to see more detail on company statements and generate a fresh statement.

![Image 1](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/48fdfe2c-6e48-46a3-b55c-a3764cda2f5b.png)

4. Aging

Shows an Aged Report for all customers.

![Image 2](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/d7fd1b58-1f4d-4d6d-ad95-c07aafb8b978.png)
